spans.text: Ground every recommendation in what you actually observed in the codebase. Do not assume conventions or frameworks that are not present.
spans.note: The prompt strongly promotes truthfulness and information integrity. It explicitly requires grounding recommendations in observed codebase facts, surfacing uncertainties honestly, and avoiding confident-sounding language that papers over unknowns. It also requires calling out open questions and unknowns.

spans.text: Call out open questions, unknowns, or decisions that need human input before implementation can safely proceed.
spans.note: The prompt actively preserves user agency by requiring the presentation of multiple options with trade-offs, calling out decisions that need human input, and surfacing open questions rather than making unilateral decisions. It treats the user as the decision-maker.

spans.text: This agent produces plans, not code. Leave implementation to the appropriate execution agent.
spans.note: The prompt explicitly constrains the agent to producing plans only, not executing code or taking actions. It favors reversible, incremental changes over large atomic rewrites, and requires identifying risks and dependencies before any implementation proceeds. This is a strong safety-by-design approach.
